notes.title: Update 1.4: Return
notes.content:
- Altered starting level for a character.
- Fixed the description for a quest.
- Added new side quests.
- Altered levels at which characters learn certain skills.
- Altered some enemy stats.
- Altered decorations and layouts for some areas.
- Improved some dialogue and fixed some typos.
- Bug fixes.

notes.title: 1.3 Update: Mind and Matter
notes.content:
- Temporarily removed the Odometer Gauge feature to wait for it to be improved.
- Added the Tertius Arena: fight waves of enemies and receive prizes.
- Added new side quests.
- Altered prices of some items.
- Altered some enemy stats.
- Altered item drop rates of certain enemies.
- Altered decorations and layouts for some areas.
- Improved some dialogue and fixed some typos.
- Bug fixes.

notes.title: 1.2 Update: Alpha Reborn
notes.content:
- Remade the beginning of the game to better explain the world and gameplay mechanics.
- Now uses a newer version of the Odometer system with more gameplay variation and fewer glitches.
- Altered the name of a location to something more fitting.
- Improved decorations for some areas.
- Altered layouts for some areas.
- Added new items.
- Added new side quests.
- Bug Fixes.

notes.title: 1.1 Update: Expansion
notes.content:
- Added access to new buildings.
- Altered some dialogue.
- A gameplay ability a character gets at one point is described more thoroughly (the vagueness of this statement is to avoid spoilers).
- Improved decorations for some areas.
- Bug Fixes.
